$comment: UI Capability Parity (CLAUDE.md): every capability whose contract declares the `app` layer is bound here to the page a person operates it on, and to the runtime artifact that proves the page works. During the Mission Control rebuild this file carries the rebuilt app's bindings while apps/app_deprecated/capability-ui-map.json still carries the deprecated app's; tools/scripts/check_ui_parity.mjs reads both and this one wins on a name they share. The cutover batch (ARCHITECTURE.md §8, WL-50) flips APP_DIR and drops the deprecated registry.

list_tool_versions.entry: Tools → Registry: the tool versions table with its consequence-tag chips, the labels/API-names toggle and the cursor pager (features/tools/registry.tsx → data/live/tools.ts versions → list_tool_versions)

import_tools.entry: Tools → Registry → "Import tools from an MCP server": the import dialog names the server and, optionally, the pins to take (features/tools/import-controls.tsx → actions.ts importTools → import_tools)

set_tool_classification.entry: Tools → Registry → a row opens the tool dialog → the reclassification form: risk grade, side effect, egress, consequence tags, data classes and the reason (features/tools/tool-dialog.tsx → actions.ts setToolClassification → set_tool_classification)

list_credential_grants.entry: Tools → Connections: the credential grants log — grant, tool server, run, connection, scope, TTL and state (features/tools/connections.tsx → data/live/tools.ts grants → list_credential_grants)

list_kill_switches.entry: Tools → Kill switches: the levels, the deny generation and a card per recorded switch with its blast radius, who flipped it and why; the tab's count is the switches denying now (features/tools/switches.tsx → data/live/tools.ts killSwitches → list_kill_switches)

set_kill_switch.entry: Tools → Kill switches → "Flip a kill switch" (and the button on each card): the switch dialog states the blast radius, the deny-generation bump and that the flip is a security event before the confirming button (features/tools/switch-controls.tsx → actions.ts flipKillSwitch → set_kill_switch)
